_README: Learned allow/block lists the classifier consults FIRST. Copy to mailmind_rules.json (git-ignored) — or just let the app create/grow it via `uv run python -m mailmind rules keep|block <sender|domain>`. keep_* protects a sender/domain from ever being auto-junked; block_* always trashes it. Domain entries also match sub-domains. Add your own employer/school/bank/clinic domains to keep_domains so they're always protected.
